segments.an10.3:1.2: avippaṭisāre asati avippaṭisāravipannassa hatūpanisaṃ hoti pāmojjaṃ;
segments.an10.3:1.3: pāmojje asati pāmojjavipannassa hatūpanisā hoti pīti;
segments.an10.3:1.4: pītiyā asati pītivipannassa hatūpanisā hoti passaddhi;
segments.an10.3:1.5: passaddhiyā asati passaddhivipannassa hatūpanisaṃ hoti sukhaṃ;
segments.an10.3:1.6: sukhe asati sukhavipannassa hatūpaniso hoti sammāsamādhi;
segments.an10.3:1.7: sammāsamādhimhi asati sammāsamādhivipannassa hatūpanisaṃ hoti yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ;
segments.an10.3:1.8: yathābhūtañāṇadassane asati yathābhūtañāṇadassanavipannassa hatūpaniso hoti nibbidāvirāgo;
segments.an10.3:1.9: nibbidāvirāge asati nibbidāvirāgavipannassa hatūpanisaṃ hoti vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ.
segments.an10.3:1.10: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, rukkho sākhāpalāsavipanno. Tassa papaṭikāpi na pāripūriṃ gacchati, tacopi… pheggupi… sāropi na pāripūriṃ gacchati.
segments.an10.3:1.11: Evamevaṃ kho, bhikkhave, dussīlassa sīlavipannassa hatūpaniso hoti avippaṭisāro;
segments.an10.3:2.2: avippaṭisāre sati avippaṭisārasampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti pāmojjaṃ;
segments.an10.3:2.3: pāmojje sati pāmojjasampannassa upanisasampannā hoti pīti;
segments.an10.3:2.4: pītiyā sati pītisampannassa upanisasampannā hoti passaddhi;
segments.an10.3:2.5: passaddhiyā sati passaddhisampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti sukhaṃ;
segments.an10.3:2.6: sukhe sati sukhasampannassa upanisasampanno hoti sammāsamādhi;
segments.an10.3:2.7: sammāsamādhimhi sati sammāsamādhisampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ;
segments.an10.3:2.8: yathābhūtañāṇadassane sati yathābhūtañāṇadassanasampannassa upanisasampanno hoti nibbidāvirāgo;
segments.an10.3:2.9: nibbidāvirāge sati nibbidāvirāgasampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ.
segments.an10.3:2.10: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, rukkho sākhāpalāsasampanno. Tassa papaṭikāpi pāripūriṃ gacchati, tacopi… pheggupi… sāropi pāripūriṃ gacchati.
segments.an10.3:2.11: Evamevaṃ kho, bhikkhave, sīlavato sīlasampannassa upanisasampanno hoti avippaṭisāro;
